summary: A2Z Cust2Mate Solutions Corp. (NASDAQ: AZ) filed a Form 6-K on July 14, 2026, reporting the appointment of Gadi Levin as CFO effective July 13, 2026, replacing Alan Rootenberg. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 states the change is immediate; no terms, compensation, or severance details are disclosed. The Board thanked the former CFO for his contributions. This is a routine executive leadership change, not an abrupt departure forced by a special situation. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves the same function as a US Form 8-K Item 5.02. No deal terms, premium, or price considerations apply. Watch for any future material events or strategic shifts under the new CFO.
